column1: # asset-content-tests.tsv — the tests that READ crates/*/src/assets/** (#8378).
# capabilities-drift.yml runs exactly these on a Cargo-inert instruction-content
# diff, where `Rust tests (affected crates)` plans nothing (owner ruling
# that job when test code reads an asset outside this list; `run` executes it
# and fails on a row that selects no test.
#   filter  `*` = the whole target; else a test-path prefix (module or test).
# A module row covers every test in it, including ones added later; a test
# row covers only that test. Prefer a test row in a large, slow module.
